integrity: Proof and exact coefficient case split included. The standalone script enumerates fields of orders 2,3,4,5,7,9; finite verification supports but does not prove the general result.
scientific_limitations: Complete all-endomorphism centralizer spectra are established only at truncation length four; the commutativity cutoff is established at all lengths. No unique historical priority or independent validation is claimed. The reference of 2015 is the motivating archival literature, not the date of the new mathematical statement.
title: Centralizer spectra and a binary commutativity cutoff for fourth-order substitution monoids
